        return
    n = int(data[0])
    x = data[1]
    ch = list(x)
    max_len = 0
    countw = 0
    i = 0

    while i < n:
        if ch[i] == '_':
            i += 1
        elif ch[i] == '(':
            open_idx = i
            count = 0
            i += 1
            while i < n and ch[i] != ')':
                if ch[i] == '_':
                    if count > 0:
                        countw += 1
                        count = 0
                elif ch[i] != '(':
                    count += 1
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                if count > 0:
                    countw += 1
                i += 1
            else:
                i = open_idx + 1
        else:
            count = 0
            while i < n and ch[i] != '_' and ch[i] != '(':
                count += 1
                i += 1
            max_len = max(max_len, count)

    print(f"{max_len} {countw}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
